book.name: Luka
book.title: Bais ula mumuru la omirong Luka aime Iesu

content: Iesu la inar teuara
Urie, no ra la o sabat, tie sade parabira namur, mela magaulap na una. Maiaram kuop ga pagap mila ame kukuf ula muru la lake marangameng ga maiaviam ga mela.
Ga amaiop iriro tadas la maialu nanam a una a la apulaimeng ara ga ula, pa tale gat ut na nanam a una.
Ga mela maiobu pa tale amaiop tongan Iesu.
Man agatmeng papot me uriro ga bangutmeng ga man maionama. Ga legimameng, narain teipien la man dusliong kagarat mai, burap liam la mitara ililakmeng.
Merau magaulap ga mainiam bugabip ma ga umai me lourup na kimanam. Pa litiro narain teipien la malilo, “Memani ga miga aisinming migana ila inim na pianam maiom teip mila uvara ra, a?
Tale gat unama to. Inar teuara. Ina onagiming urie ties la ualo Iesu miun na tara la unama Galili.
La miulo gare ro, ‘Eba maialang Migana migat ang Morowa na kilalap ma inamaniap o kirinim ga eba asopmeng iro maiogun. Pa na la lama naien la eba ina teara.’”
Ga oagatmeng uriro ties la uaramo Iesu tinan.
Urie, amaiolai una ga ina mela na taun Ierusalem. Ga mamelo 11 ma lop am o usingnualap ga non gat teip ma miriro pagap la magimameng.
Miriro magaulap la maialo ties maun Apostolop are ro: Maria onim Makdala ga Ioana ga Maria naga ang Iemes ga non gat magaulap la maionama ga mirie ga maialo uriro ties maun Apostolop.
Pa Apostolop la magatmeng magaulap namo ga maiaramot ties agarit. Ga tale kan naganmeng iro ties maiong.

Pa teuara Petro ga ibirong ga ula na una. Ga kumuong ga kiraong tapma, ga magimaong it burap la maiot pa tongan la ular. Urie, inar terigiong me na luguan ga agatong papot me miriro pagap la betmeng ara.
Narain teipien la agimaliong Iesu na alang me Emaus
Urie, na uriro kan sande, narain lopien angan o usingnualap la maliolai ga namo lila na non tatak pianam la meivo Emaus. Uriro alang la maio Ierusalem ga ila Emaus, puoieng gare 11 kilometa.
Man linum ga lila ga man tiesliong ma mirier pagap la betmeng.
Na tara la man linum ga tiesliong ga man nemarikliong a muana ma miriro pagap, tie betong Iesu li ga unum ga ula ga litie.
Agimaliong Iesu, pa paga la manoun irap lie ga tale alit irie Iesu.
Tie, lemarikong Iesu, “Man paga la man marama kabirana me ga man manum ga mala?” Lipto uriro ties ga dusliong ga tale tegisliong ga pavap lie la kiram o kadik aime Iesu.

Pa non migana bonim a Kilopas la upulo ties ang gare ro, “Papot ma inamaniap onim na non ara pialap titot la maionama Ierusalem. Atabo nunuot narit migana la tale manit pagap la betmeng Ierusalem na iriro tara, a?”

Pa lemarikong Iesu, “Man pagap?” Urie, alilo, “Mirio pagap la betmeng ira Iesu onim Nasaret. Irie unuli ga ume okosarong ubi ula mamaranu ga ties gat ula mamaranu na irap a Morowa ga na irap ma teip ga magaulap.
Pa miridaip buam mila kakanim ga teip mila uke onim Israel la maiabua na kilalap ma karorap am. Ga meburio ties meba menamung ga aving ga asapmeng iro maiogun.
Pa tinan la agatpang gare ro, Iriro migana la eba ina emung Israel. Ga non gat ties aime. Titot naien ara ma lap la aipmeng ira ma miro pagap la betmeng.
Pa non magaulap gat a gar pang la pakosarmeng ga turuppaba kan kirat; La mela parabirat namur na una,
Ga tale kan agimameng tongan Iesu. Ga ina terigimeng ga tiesmeng gare ro: Magimapang non angelop, ga megama, ‘Ina ra inim.’
Pa non migana kabirana pa la ula na una, ga agimaong paga gare tie la tiesmeng magaulap a. Pa tale kan agimaong Iesu.”
Urie, Iesu la leulo, “Teivuo! Banbanan mang! Ga dalap me la tale temaiara kakalait meba nagan mang me mirier tiesiap unulip onim tinan la maiaramam!
Are mani? Atabo tale kan amet, Karisito leba ka lake aving ngitngit ga tubiat eba bat arang kaguma ila kakani aun Morowa na panbinim?”
Ga puaro Iesu ties ang Moses la omirong ga ma mirie tiesiap maiam unulip onim tinan la mamirmeng, ga uaramo uriro ties li ma muap ma mirie napup o babam ula puaru la tiesieng aime kan.
Pa man menum ga mela kagarat u urie pianam la namo lila una. Pa namo ra man aipang Iesu ga ala rot kirat.
Pa liana ga ligama, “Mumuru le ka nonang ga ii. Memani, namor namila muabari ga tatak ara nap meba arubu ba.” Are ratmat ga ula uobu Iesu na luguan ga unama ga litie.
Tubiat la namo parakmeng, ga unama Iesu ga litie. Ga uaro purun ga ivo temaieng me aun Morowa ga opakoula ga ualo liun.
Okosarong Iesu gare tiro, urie irap lie la menava bat, ga alit iriro migana irie Iesu. Pa talet kagat ga karuk aime ga tale gat agimaliong.

Pa man tiesliong kabirana lie, “Teivuo, man binum it ga irie na alanag ga man ualo ties biun ga ovikpikong ties na Babam ula puaru bii. A iriro tara, dalap bi la mitara kakarameba gare kit ga tebiba maset, a?”
Ga kakalait teliara ot urie la ga terigiliong me toruan Ierusalem. Ga maliop 11 ma lop am o usingnualap la iat nebolameng ga non gat inamaniap la iat man maionama ga mirie.
Ga lemelo, “Maptang! Migat ara, Ila Kakani la inar teuara! Simon la agimaong ara!”
Urie, baisliong ma mirier pagap la betmeng ira lie na alang. Ga ligama, “Opukoula purun ga urie arakiing bat la irie Iesu.”
Lop o usingnualap la agimameng Iesu
Tie, man liaramam ka miriro pagap, urie Iesu kan la dusong kabirana ma. Ga ugama maime, “Malina le ot na dalap mi.”
Pa turupmaiaba ga merau maset. Memani, agatmeng namo ga agimameng ara noba muranama.
Pa maulo Iesu, “Memani ga turupmiaba, a? Memani ga papot agat la betieng na dalap mi?
Legimaming kilalapien tuo ga kibapien tuo. Turuo kan tiro. Paming ira ruo ga uming, memani, muranap la tale kan memaning pupunesip ga mualap are tiro la magimaming ira ruo.”
Tiesong ara gare tiro ga lesinguala kilalapien a ga kibapien a mai.
Mitara temeba maset pa tale ka naganmeng. Ga mitara agatmeng papot. Are ratmat ga mamarikong, “Atabo parakiap ba mim mirie la maiot to?”
Urie, maiala nap a abuluma aun la meburua.
Uara ga u iriro nap a abuluma na irap ma.

Urie, maulo Iesu, “Tinan la tunama ka ga mimi, ga mirulo ra gare ro. Mirier pagap ganam tinan la mamirmeng teip me rulam na maimai ang Moses ga na babam maiong unulip ga babam o punuarap, eba betmeng gare tiro. Mirio tiesiap ganam la betmeng migat gare tiro titot.”
Urie, Iesu la unavo agat maiong meba ameira muana o Babam ula puaru.
Maulo gare ro, “Babam ula puaru la tiesieng aime Karisito leba aving ngitngit, pa na la lama naien la eba ina teara na una.
Pa na bonim a, eba baismeng o bais ula mumuru mai mirier garip ma inamaniap, geba marigimeng dalap ma, ga maduratang Morowa kirinimup maiam. Pumiarang uriro ubi togo Ierusalem.
Mimi le baisming ma miriro pagap la magimaming ga miptam.

Miptang! Uriro kamniap tinan Mamo la tiesong ume la namo alang miun, kagarat it ga eba osagarang ga muiong miun. Pa mionang it na uriro taun puoieng na tara Muranam Ila Babai leba muong mi ga kukunim onim na panbinim leba muiong miun.”
Morowa la ina alagiong Iesu ga ula na panbinim
Urie, malagiong ga omaiolai taun Ierusalem ga mela puoieng na pianam Betania. Ga uavia kilan a me nakap ga ualo ugiginara maun.
Man ualo ka Iesu ugiginara maun urie maulai ga alagiong Morowa ga ula na panbinim.
Ga lotumeng me ai Iesu ga ina terigimeng me na taun Ierusalem un tenubap ula kakanu.
Ga man maionama na luguan o lotu ga man lotumeng me ai Morowa.
